tools.name: find_salons
tools.description: Find nail salons that take bookings on Lacquer, by US city + state or ZIP code, optionally narrowed by salon name. Up to 20 results.

tools.name: get_salon
tools.description: A salon's address, phone, weekly hours and full service menu (service_id, price, duration).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open start times for one service, any technician. Pass a start_at from here to book_appointment unchanged. Searches from now when no date is given; up to 7 days.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment. Real and immediate: the salon holds the time and the customer gets a confirmation text. Confirm every detail with the person first. Retrying the same call returns the same booking, never a second one.
